class.name: AssetTagManager
class.brief_description: Manages the project asset tag dictionary.
class.description: Singleton that stores hierarchical asset tags, supports CRUD operations, and validates tag hierarchy semantics.

method.name: abort_batch
method.description: Discards the active dictionary batch without persisting changes.

method.name: add_tag
method.description: Adds [param tag_name] to the dictionary with optional [param comment] and [param source]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the name is invalid or already present.

method.name: begin_batch
method.description: Starts a nested dictionary batch so multiple mutations can be committed together.

method.name: commit_batch
method.description: Ends one batch level and optionally persists the dictionary when [param persist] is [code]true[/code]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if saving fails.

method.name: container_has_all
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param container] matches every tag in [param query_tags], including hierarchical parent matches.

method.name: container_has_any
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param container] matches at least one tag in [param query_tags].

method.name: container_has_tag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param container] contains [param tag] or a hierarchical child of it.

method.name: get_tag_info
method.description: Returns metadata for [param tag_name], including comment and source fields when the tag exists.

method.name: has_tag_in_dictionary
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param tag_name] exists in the dictionary after alias resolution.

method.name: list_all_tags
method.description: Returns every tag name currently stored in the dictionary.

method.name: list_tags
method.description: Returns direct child tags of [param parent_tag], or root tags when [param parent_tag] is empty.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads the tag dictionary from disk. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the file cannot be read.

method.name: matches_tag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param tag] equals [param query_tag] or is a hierarchical descendant of it.

method.name: remove_tag
method.description: Removes [param tag_name] from the dictionary and records a redirect. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the tag is missing.

method.name: rename_tag
method.description: Renames [param old_name] to [param new_name] and updates redirects. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the rename is invalid.

method.name: resolve_tag_alias
method.description: Resolves [param tag_name] through redirects and returns the canonical dictionary name.

method.name: save
method.description: Persists the tag dictionary to disk. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if writing fails.

method.name: update_tag_comment
method.description: Sets the comment text for [param tag_name]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the tag is missing.

signal.name: redirects_changed
signal.description: Emitted when tag rename/remove redirects are updated.

signal.name: tag_dictionary_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the tag dictionary contents change.
